# temps_error_alert_rule (Resource)

Notifies when a project's error tracking sees a new issue, a regression, a burst and more.

Temps creates two rules for every project (*New issue detected* and *Regression detected*); import them to manage them, or leave them alone.

Temps cannot remove `environment_id` or `error_type` from a rule, so removing either replaces the rule.

Import with `<project_id>/<rule_id>`.

Required API key permissions: `error_tracking:read`, `error_tracking:create`, `error_tracking:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "temps_environment" "production" {
  project_id = temps_project.web.id
  name       = "production"
}

# Alert when production sees more than 100 errors of one issue in an hour.
resource "temps_error_alert_rule" "burst" {
  project_id       = temps_project.web.id
  name             = "error burst"
  trigger_type     = "frequency"
  trigger_config   = jsonencode({ count = 100, window_minutes = 60 })
  environment_id   = data.temps_environment.production.id
  priority         = "Critical"
  cooldown_minutes = 15
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Rule name.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project. Changing it replaces the rule.
- `trigger_type` (String) What fires the rule: one of `frequency`, `new_issue`, `new_user`, `regression`, `status_change`, `user_count`.

### Optional

- `cooldown_minutes` (Number) Minimum minutes between notifications for the same rule and error. Defaults to `30`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule fires. Defaults to `true`.
- `environment_id` (Number) Only fire for errors in this environment of the project. Removing it replaces the rule.
- `error_type` (String) Only fire for errors of this type, compared without case, for example `TypeError`. Removing it replaces the rule.
- `priority` (String) Notification priority: `Low`, `Normal`, `High` (the default) or `Critical`.
- `trigger_config` (String) Trigger settings as JSON. `frequency` needs `count` and `window_minutes` (`jsonencode({ count = 100, window_minutes = 60 })`); `user_count` needs `threshold`; the others take `{}`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Numeric rule ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import temps_error_alert_rule.burst 3/41
```
